title: Ohm Brew Core Watermelon Sugar 50/50 E-Liquid
description: Watermelon Sugar from Ohm Brew’s Core range of Freebase e-liquids gives the delicately sweet and refreshing watermelon flavour a sugary candy twist with deliciously moreish results. Ohm Brew’s Core range recaptures the original magic of freebase nicotine e-liquids. Freebase nicotine is a form of nicotine with an alkaline formula, which offers more of a tactile ‘throat hit’ than nic salt e-liquids. Their throat sensation closely mimics the draw of a traditional cigarette, only the taste is far more delicious! Ohm Brew’s Core range of Freebase e-liquids are ideal for use in classic e-cigarette starter vape kits and pod kits .
